//: Example WorldMap configuration. Copy values into appsettings.{Environment}.json, user-secrets, or environment variables. DO NOT commit real onboarding tokens, secrets, or connection strings.

Storage.//: Provider must be 'InMemory' or 'Cosmos'. InMemory is non-durable and blocked outside Development unless AllowInMemoryOutsideDevelopment is set.
Storage.//BootstrapEnabled: Default false. Set true only for explicit dev/first-run provisioning; normal runtime validates required containers via /health/ready.
Storage.//SingleWriterLease: The World runs at scale=1. A Cosmos instance must hold this lease to be ready and run background mutations; a second live instance is rejected and fails readiness.

Onboarding.//: Operator-preprovisioned onboarding records. Prefer TokenHash (lowercase-hex SHA-256 of the token); a raw Token is hashed at startup and discarded. Each token binds a civ to a fixed civId/keyId and a secretRef resolved from Secrets:Map.

Secrets.//: Reference -> secret map. In App Service these are settings backed by Key Vault references; locally use user-secrets/env. Never commit real secrets.
